# The Diver's Boat Koh Phangan

> SSI dive centre in Chaloklum, Koh Phangan, Thailand, with its own boat. Daily 9:30 departures to Sail Rock, Koh Ma, Little Sail Rock and the oil platform. Small groups (maximum 20 divers on board), new 2024 equipment, taught in English, Spanish and French. Opened January 2024; part of The Diver's Boat, on Koh Tao since 2015. More than 400 divers certified since opening.

## Key facts

- Location: 25, 47 Moo 7, Chaloklum, Koh Phangan, Surat Thani 84280, Thailand (north coast of Koh Phangan). The boat leaves from Chaloklum pier. Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/bEEDKP3wQrKL8BUb9
- Shop hours: every day, 9:00–19:00. Open all year; during the monsoon (roughly November to mid-December) boats don't go out on days when the sea is unsafe.
- Contact and booking: WhatsApp / phone +66 95 438 5374 · thaidivingpro@gmail.com · Instagram @thediversboatkpg
- Booking and payment: deposit to confirm; cash or Revolut. Full refund if the centre cancels the boat because of the weather (the centre decides, based on sea conditions).
- Getting there: no hotel pick-ups. Renting a scooter (about 250฿ a day) is cheaper than island taxis.
- Certification agency: SSI (Scuba Schools International). SSI dive centre page: https://www.divessi.com/en/divecenter/the-divers-boat-surat-thani-thailand-766677
- Boat: the Rungworawan, our own boat, maximum 20 divers. All diving equipment is kept on board.
- The day: fill in the registration forms at the shop the day before; on the day, meet at the boat on Chaloklum pier at 9:15. Departure 9:30, back around 15:00 (in time for a 17:00 ferry).
- Group sizes: Try Dive 2 students per instructor; Open Water 4 students per instructor; Fun Dive 4 divers per guide
- Minimum ages: Try Dive 8 years; Basic Diver and Open Water 10 years
- Teaching languages: English, Spanish, French. Italian and German for much of the season, Russian on some dates. Office: English and Chinese.
- Included in every price: SSI instructor or guide, full equipment (XS to XXL, new 2024), a hot lunch with rice between dives, plenty of fruit, hot and cold drinks, underwater video of your dive
- Google rating: 5.0 from 354 reviews (September 2026)

## Prices (Thai baht, per person)

Most popular: Try Dive, Fun Dive and the SSI Open Water course.

- Snorkelling trip to Sail Rock: 1,500฿ (1 day)
- Fun Dive for certified divers: 3,200฿ (1 day)
- Try Dive, no certification needed: 4,200฿ (1 day, from 8 years)
- SSI Basic Diver: 4,900฿ (1 day, from 10 years)
- SSI Open Water Diver: 12,900฿ (3 days, to 18 m, from 10 years). Day 1: theory review and skills in shallow water in Chaloklum Bay (a pool only if the sea doesn't allow it); days 2–3: open-water dives at Sail Rock, or calmer Koh Ma when the sea or the students need it. SSI e-learning available from booking. Ages 10–14 certify as Junior Open Water.
- SSI Advanced Open Water: 12,500฿ (2 days, 5 adventure dives: Deep and Navigation required, usually Perfect Buoyancy, Photography and Fish ID; certifies to 30 m, 21 m for ages 12–14; from 12 years; Open Water is enough, no extra dives needed; usually at Sail Rock, January–May also Koh Ma or Little Sail Rock). SSI renamed Advanced Adventurer to Advanced Open Water in early 2026; 4 specialties + 24 dives is now Advanced Specialty Diver.
- SSI Specialty Diver: 13,500฿ (2 days) — we recommend Deep + Nitrox as the next step after Open Water. 4 dives at Sail Rock: three Deep dives (18–24 m, 24–30 m, 30–40 m) and one on Nitrox. Theory on the boat (the hour out to Sail Rock and the surface interval); written exam at the shop on the last day. From 15 years. Usually taught by Boris in English or Spanish.
- SSI Deep Diving Specialty: 8,500฿ (2 days, to 40 m, from 15 years)
- SSI Rescue Diver: 11,600฿ (2 days)
- SSI Enriched Air Nitrox: 4,500฿ theory only, or 7,500฿ with 2 dives on nitrox (from 15 years)

## Dive sites and seasons

- Water temperature 28–30°C all year.
- Sail Rock (Hin Bai): open-sea pinnacle, 5–40 m, with The Chimney swim-through (vertical tunnel, top opening at 6 m, bottom at 18 m, window in the wall at 10–14 m; usually swum top to bottom to avoid uncontrolled ascents; open to the surface, so no special course needed). Current usually hits only one side of the rock. Barracuda, batfish, trevally, whale sharks with luck. About 1 hour by boat. All levels. Clearest May–October (often 20–30 m visibility); January–April more plankton (about 5–10 m), which feeds the big schools and the whale sharks.
- Koh Ma: hard-coral garden 10 minutes from Chaloklum, 5–18 m, no current. Turtles, clownfish, cuttlefish. Beginners and courses. Clearest January–June.
- Little Sail Rock: small pinnacle, 8–20 m, few other divers. Giant groupers, morays, fusiliers. Intermediate. Clearest January–June.
- Oil Platform: artificial structure in open water, 10–30 m, huge schools of jacks, barracuda and groupers. Advanced, 20+ logged dives.
- Whale sharks: textbook season April–June, but seen in February and September too; never guaranteed.

## Team

- Boris Collado — manager and lead instructor, SSI Instructor #112758. Dive professional since 2015, instructor since 2022, more than 5,000 dives. Leads the instructors and divemasters.
- Ruiyao (Rui) Wang — manager, runs the office and bookings.
- The centre is owned by The Diver's Boat, which also runs The Diver's Boat Koh Tao (https://www.thediversboat.com/).
